# pcd_compute_keypair (Resource)

Manages an SSH keypair in PCD's compute (Nova) service. If public_key is omitted, Nova generates a keypair and returns the private key once (on create).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_compute_keypair" "example" {
  name       = "tf-example-keypair"
  public_key = "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABgExampleKeyMaterial user@example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the keypair. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) The public key. If omitted, one is generated. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `user_id` (String) The user that owns the keypair. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) The keypair fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Mirrors name.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The generated private key (only set when public_key was not supplied).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_compute_keypair.example <name>
```
